help: Filter shapes the tone around the cutoff frequency. LP (low-pass) keeps lower frequencies; HP (high-pass) keeps higher frequencies; BP (band-pass) keeps a band around the cutoff. Q controls resonance: higher Q makes a sharper peak near the cutoff.
